name: Deycas Alcelait
original_name: ディーサス・アルスライト
source:
Liphia's childhood friend and a royal knight. He has excellent judgment and is always calm, but he also has many reactions that are appropriate for his age.

Ever since he met the protagonist in the royal capital, he has been in love with her, but his overly cautious personality and the protagonist's older brother have become obstacles, so no progress has been made yet.

[Translated from [url=http://fleur0.starfree.jp/chara.html]official website[/url]]

Flower Emblem: Anemone
